zh.name: 宇宙打印机
zh.body: 某种不合常理的打印机。直接使用存储网络中的材料，自动执行控制核心的制作任务。
effects: 每台打印机可独立调整速度、产出效率、技能等级和品质参数。
制作任务可设为“仅打印机”。

en.name: Cosmic Printer
en.body: A printer that defies common sense. Uses materials directly from the storage network to automatically carry out the control core's production orders.
effects: Individually adjust each printer's speed, output efficiency, skill level and quality settings.
Production orders can be set to "Printers only".
